units: mean median-normalised, ORF-length-normalised expression values as deposited

replicates.text: one RNA-seq sample per time point and condition (Table S7C); no replicates deposited

lightIntensity.text: 100 μE m-2 s-1 (μmoles photons m-2 s-1), cool fluorescent light

lightRegime.text: cool fluorescent light; entrained by two 12 h dark/12 h light cycles, then released into continuous light
lightRegime.where: GEO GSE51112 !Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1; Markson et al. 2013 Supplemental Information, Extended Experimental Procedures, Cell Culture (read in full 2026-10-06; package B/C addendum)
lightRegime.quote: cultures were grown in tissue culture flasks illuminated with 100 mE m-2 s-1 (mmoles photons m-2 s-1) of cool fluorescent light and bubbled continuously with 1% CO2 in air, with the OD750 maintained near 0.3 by diluting the cultures every four hours with fresh medium. Medium was supplemented with 10 mM HEPES-KOH pH 8.0 maintain the pH.

medium.text: BG-11M with 10 mM HEPES-KOH pH 8.0; strain-specific antibiotics at inoculation only, absent after dilution

phase.label: OD stated
phase.text: OD750 held near 0.3 by periodic dilution through the experiment

caveat: Measured in PCC 7942, not UTEX 2973; one sample per time point, so no replicate band exists, and the six circadian time points are averaged, which removes the rhythm the study was designed around.

layers.label: Expression GSE51112 WT constant light ZT24–44 (PCC 7942)

layers.strain: PCC 7942 OX-D53E (ΔrpaA ΔkaiBC, Ptrc::rpaA D53E; EOC346)
